# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** open an issue using the feature request template.
- **Bugs:** use the bug report template. Include your versions and the exact error text.
- **Maigret itself** (site detection, false positives, new sites, report options): report these to the [maigret project](https://github.com/soxoj/maigret/issues). This server only calls maigret.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report privately via [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/w0h1v/mcp-maigret/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
